The '''Intelligence Archives''' was the secured section of the [[Imperial Intelligence Headquarters (Dromund Kaas)|Imperial Intelligence Headquarters]] located in the [[Imperial Citadel (Sith Empire)|Imperial Citadel]] on [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]]. Around [[3642 BBY]] [[Cipher Nine]] faked a power shutdown in its security systems to secretly search for information on [[Thesh protocol]]s.
